name: Pegboard wall
notes: Back plane at z = 0 facing +Z, bottom edge at y = 0; scenes lift it. Depth includes hung items.
parts: 1/8 in tempered hardboard sheet with 1/4 in holes on a 1 in grid
1x2 pine furring strips behind the sheet
screws with washers into the furring
coiled orange extension cord with plug and socket ends
two spare circular saw blades on a hook
style: used home shop wall: some holes grimy from hooks, cord loosely coiled, bins with screws
summary: 4 x 4 ft hardboard pegboard on furring strips with steel hooks holding an extension cord, a rope coil, a parts-bin shelf and spare saw blades.
